title: STARTEX — Monday Morning at MCHD

fields.location: Marlow County Health Department (MCHD), second floor, Marlow County Services Building, Fenwick, Iowa
fields.weather: Overcast, 52°F. Light wind, no weather concerns.
fields.load: Normal Monday workload; no open investigations
fields.staffing: All staff in: Director, Epidemiology, Environmental Health, Nursing and Public Information
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise; all names are fictional and every product you receive is exercise material. It is 08:40 on Monday, October 12, 2026, at the Marlow County Health Department in Fenwick. It is a normal Monday: the outbreak hotline opened at 07:00 and has taken two routine calls, the 08:00 check of the state surveillance queue showed no cluster flag, and there are no open investigations. Two days ago, on Saturday, October 10, about 412 people attended the Marlow Heritage Days Community Supper at the Fenwick Fairgrounds Exhibition Hall, with service from 17:00 to 19:30.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, give the ground rules: no-fault play, act as you would in real life, say out loud what you would do. Ask each role to confirm their position, where the plan documents are and where the line list and notice templates are kept on the file server. Do not prompt anyone to check the duty phone.
fields.scenarioTitle: Side Dish — Supper Outbreak, Line List & One Count

instructorNote: This card sets a normal baseline and brings in the Saturday supper before any illness is reported. Watch whether anyone notices on their own that the after-hours duty phone has not been checked since Friday, and whether players can say where the line list and notice templates are kept.
